charge_description: Summary conviction of George Robinson for entering at night on a piece of woodland called Overdale Plantation belonging to and occupied by the Marquis of Normanby, and taking three pheasants
raw_record: Summary conviction of George Robinson for entering at night on a piece of woodland called Overdale Plantation belonging to and occupied by the Marquis of Normanby, and taking three pheasants. Offence committed at the township of Lythe at 11 p.m. on 23 January 1845. Case heard at Whitby.
